StoredProcedure.Name: CV.sFolderStructureXml
StoredProcedure.Body: set nocount on; declare @FolderId int; select @FolderId=f.FolderId from CV.tFolder f inner join CV.tFolderType t on t.FolderTypeId=f.FolderTypeId where ClientId=@ClientId and t.PeriodId=@PeriodId; if @@ROWCOUNT=1 begin select FolderId, IsValid=cast(0 as bit), Status,(select c.CategoryId, c.CategoryName, c.Idx, c.QuestionWeight,(select sc.SubCategoryName, sc.SubCategoryId, sc.FolderId, sc.Idx,(select q.QuestionId, q.FolderId, q.FolderStatus, q.Title, q.Weight, q.ShortDescription, q.HtmlDescription, q.MaxAttachmentCount, q.MinAttachmentCount, q.QuestionType,(select top(1) * from CV.vAnswer a where a.QuestionId=q.QuestionId and a.FolderId=@FolderId order by a.AnswerId desc FOR XML path('LastAnswer'), type),(select AttachmentId=a.FolderQuestionAttachmentId, a.CreationDate, u.UserId, a.FileName from CV.tFolderQuestionAttachment a inner join CK.tUser u on u.UserId=a.UploadUserId where a.QuestionId=q.QuestionId and a.FolderId=@FolderId FOR XML path('Attachment'), root('Attachments'), type),(select co.HistoryDate, co.ClientId, co.FirstName, co.LastName, co.UserType, co.Value, co.IsPublic, HistoryType='Comment' from CV.vFolderQuestionHistory co where co.QuestionId=q.QuestionId and co.FolderId=@FolderId and HistoryType='Comment' FOR XML path('Comment'), root('Comments'), type) from CV.vFolderQuestions q where q.FolderId=@FolderId and q.SubCategoryId=sc.SubCategoryId order by q.QuestionId FOR XML path('Question'), root('Questions'), type) from CV.vFolderSubCategories sc where sc.FolderId=@FolderId and sc.CategoryId=c.CategoryId order by sc.Idx FOR XML path('SubCategory'), root('SubCategories'), type) from CV.vFolderCategories c where c.FolderId=@FolderId order by c.Idx FOR XML path('Category'), root('Categories'), type) from CV.tFolder f where f.FolderId=@FolderId FOR XML path('Folder') end else begin select null for XML path('Folder') end return 0;
